claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, this ATP1A1 (Na+/K+-ATPase) inhibitor most plausibly kills cells through a cardiac glycoside-like Na+/K+-ATPase inhibition that is largely cytostatic/weakly cytotoxic and not selectively dependent on any single oncogenic lineage.
